Stable tie-cell straps captured before POR release plus IGNORE255 guarantee unchanged host+D+2+L cold/warm release. 38flops vs30, one root, same12.96x12.96M5relay slot. Every input remains audited; no strap mask.
slot_change_request: Same12.96x12.96M5reset relay slot, same a W/b E/ck S/POR+dly N faces. Additive master qkd_rst_region_pr; original CLOSED root stands. New master unbound until exact/mutant/native/TT/FF/DRC gates.

job.purpose: Register static delay straps at their pins without changing the existing reset-release calendar. OriginalRTL cycle-for-cycle comparison plus chain/hold calendar checks.

reroute_reason.why: native successor of qkd_rst_region ec1 (CLOSED TT +277.01 / FF +30.02, native FAIL capture 239.9 ps on all 8 dly strap pins: the cnt == dly compare hung off the N-face pins, R 48.5). qkd_rst_region_pr captures every dly bit in a pin flop (dly_pin, keep) in a wrapper; core byte-identical; 0 production cycles (dly is static: tie strap or POR-time die cfg, sampled every cycle, settled inside IGNORE=255). Die adopts with OT_KV_RST_PIN_REG=1 (kv_die.py SPLIT_BINDINGS). ELEM-GAPS/KV 10-18; supersedes the unsubmitted KVE fq1 in-place edit (claude/kve-1017 ecc9208e1).
